writing.overall_comment: A solid framework-aware frontend agent that routes well and sets clear standards, but it lacks an output contract and explicit scope boundaries or hand-back rules.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names triggers (building/styling/refactoring components, pages, state logic) and target frameworks, so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, constraints, and standards are explicit, but there is no output contract describing the expected deliverable format or artifact.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A generic DON'T list exists, but there are no hard limits (e.g., no backend/API changes, no deployment) or explicit hand-back/escalation conditions.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Generally tight, though framework detection is repeated across Core Responsibilities, Framework-Specific Focus, and Workflow, and several bullet lists could be merged.

suggestions: Add explicit hard limits and hand-back/escalation conditions to the Boundaries/DON'T list section, such as prohibitions on backend/API changes and deployment.
Add an output contract section to the prompt that specifies the expected deliverable format or artifact.
Consolidate repeated framework detection from Core Responsibilities, Framework-Specific Focus, and Workflow into a single section and merge overlapping bullet lists.
